/**
 * @name Unsafe sinks (eval, exec, pickle)
 * @description specific unsafe sinks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-sinks-check
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall()
select call, "Potential unsafe operation using eval, exec, or deserialization."
findings.hypothesis: Use of eval, exec, or unsafe deserialization can lead to arbitrary code execution.

/**
 * @name Potential SSRF or Insecure SSL in JWKS Client
 * @description Detects potential Server-Side Request Forgery or insecure SSL usage in JWKS client.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity high
 * @id py/jwt-ssrf-insecure-ssl
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-918
 *       external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember("urlopen").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib.request").getMember("urlopen").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember("get").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember("post").getACall()
  )
select call, "Network request found. Check for SSRF or insecure SSL configuration."
findings.hypothesis: The JWKS client might perform network requests to arbitrary URLs (SSRF) or fail to verify SSL certificates.
